notes.agrum: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.genfer: Genfer answers dice2genfer.py's translation of the Dice program in floating point, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.geni: Geni computes in single precision and prints seven decimals, so differences of up to 5e-8 from the reference are its print precision.
notes.libdai: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pgmpy: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads.
notes.pluck: The time is the whole process's, with Julia loading Pluck; the tables take Pluck's own time, the warm one where it ran a second time in the process, else the in-process one.
notes.prism: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value. The time includes the JVM's start.
notes.psi: Psi answers dice2psi.py's translation of the Dice program exactly, one run per component of the program's value, the times added.
notes.scallop: Scallop keeps every proof of each tuple (its top-k proofs at the largest k its command line takes), so its answer is exact. The time includes tddlog's grounding of the program, which Scallop reads.
notes.storm: The model is the Markov chain dice2prism.py writes of the Dice program, a model per component of its value.
notes.tensorinference: Reads the UAI file and the observations that Merlin reads; the time is the whole process's, and the tables take its own, timed as Alea.jl's after a warm-up on a small model (warm-up s): the warm one where it solved the instance a second time in the process (where the first took under a third of the limit), else the in-process one less Julia's compilation within it (compile s); without Julia's start and the package's load, with the search for a contraction order.

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/tugofwar.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: tugofwar.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
players = Vector(undef, 6)

players[1] = discrete(DistUInt{9}, [0.015625, 0.09375, 0.234375, 0.3125, 0.234375, 0.09375, 0.015625]) + DistUInt{9}(142);
players[2] = discrete(DistUInt{9}, [0.015625, 0.09375, 0.234375, 0.3125, 0.234375, 0.09375, 0.015625]) + DistUInt{9}(146);
players[3] = discrete(DistUInt{9}, [0.015625, 0.09375, 0.234375, 0.3125, 0.234375, 0.09375, 0.015625]) + DistUInt{9}(150);
players[4] = discrete(DistUInt{9}, [0.015625, 0.09375, 0.234375, 0.3125, 0.234375, 0.09375, 0.015625]) + DistUInt{9}(143);
players[5] = discrete(DistUInt{9}, [0.015625, 0.09375, 0.234375, 0.3125, 0.234375, 0.09375, 0.015625]) + DistUInt{9}(145);
players[6] = discrete(DistUInt{9}, [0.015625, 0.09375, 0.234375, 0.3125, 0.234375, 0.09375, 0.015625]) + DistUInt{9}(140);


cheat_player = uniform(DistUInt{3}, 0, 6)
cheat_player2 = uniform(DistUInt{3}, 0, 6)
observe(!prob_equals(cheat_player, cheat_player2))

final_players = Vector(undef, 6)
for i in 1:6
    final_players[i] = ifelse(prob_equals(cheat_player, DistUInt{3}(i-1)) | prob_equals(cheat_player2, DistUInt{3}(i-1)), players[i]+DistUInt{9}(10), players[i])
end

a = final_players[1]
b = final_players[2]
c = final_players[3]
d = final_players[4]
e = final_players[5]
f = final_players[6]


result_3 = a+b+e<c+d+f
result_5 = a+c+d<b+e+f
result_6 = a+c+e<b+d+f
result_10 = a+e+f<b+c+d

observe(result_3 & result_5 & result_6 & result_10)
(cheat_player == DistUInt{3}(5)) | (cheat_player2 == DistUInt{3}(5))
end

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/plankton.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5

# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Not in Table 1 of Cao et al. (UAI 2023).
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
    function binomial(n::DistUInt{W}, p, max::Int) where W
        output = DistUInt{W}(0)
        for i in 0:max-1
            output += ifelse((DistUInt{W}(i)<n) & flip(p), DistUInt{W}(1), DistUInt{W}(0))
        end
        return output
    end


    param = uniform(DistUInt{7}, 10, 51)
    planktoncount = binomial(param, 0.5, 50)
    planktoncount
end

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/book_mod.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,

# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: book.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
curValue = uniform(DistInt{14}, 1, 501)
tgtValue = uniform(DistInt{14}, 1, 501)



delta = tgtValue - curValue

for i=1:1
    d = ifelse((delta < DistInt{14}(5)) & (delta > DistInt{14}(-5)),
        DistInt{14}(0),
        ifelse(delta < DistInt{14}(0),

            ifelse(delta > DistInt{14}(-25),
            delta + uniform(DistInt{14}, -10, 11),
            ifelse(delta > DistInt{14}(-50),
            delta + uniform(DistInt{14}, -20, 21),
            ifelse(delta > DistInt{14}(-100),
            delta + uniform(DistInt{14}, -50, 51),
            delta + uniform(DistInt{14}, -100, 101)))),

            ifelse(delta < DistInt{14}(25),
            delta + uniform(DistInt{14}, -10, 11),
            ifelse(delta < DistInt{14}(50),
            delta + uniform(DistInt{14}, -20, 21),
            ifelse(delta < DistInt{14}(100),
            delta + uniform(DistInt{14}, -50, 51),
            delta + uniform(DistInt{14}, -100, 101))))
        )
    )

    curValue = curValue + d

    curValue = ifelse(curValue > DistInt{14}(500),
                    DistInt{14}(500),
                ifelse(curValue < DistInt{14}(1),
                    DistInt{14}(1),
                    curValue))

    delta = tgtValue - curValue
end

(delta < DistInt{14}(5)) && (delta > DistInt{14}(-5))
end

# Ported from experiments/dicejl/radar.jl of Tractables/Alea.jl,
# branch arithmetic, commit 7e9ff23517086eb4518845e50218bf18b4d9f2a5
# (Apache License 2.0). Mechanical port: Dice -> Alea, @dice -> @alea, the
# BenchmarkTools harness dropped, the query moved to QUERY.
# Cao, Garg, Holtzen, Van den Broeck, Millstein (UAI 2023), Table 1: radar1.
using Alea

const QUERY = :pr

model() = @alea begin
    w = 10

    function T(mu, l, r)
        x = uniform(DistInt{w}, -l, 1) + uniform(DistInt{w}, 0, l+1)
        y = uniform(DistInt{w}, -r, 1) + uniform(DistInt{w}, 0, r+1)
        observe(x <= DistInt{w}(0) && y > DistInt{w}(0))

        return ifelse(flip(l/(l+r)), x, y) + mu
    end

    b1 = flip(0.2)
    b2 = ifelse(b1, true, flip(0.2))
    x1 = uniform(DistInt{w}, 0, 11)
    x2 = uniform(DistInt{w}, -2, 3) + x1

    o1 = x1 + ifelse(b1, T(x1, 5, 1), T(x1, 5, 5))
    o2 = x2 + ifelse(b2, T(x2, 5, 1), T(x2, 5, 5))

    observe(o1 == DistInt{w}(5));
    observe(b1)

    x2

    # T(DistInt{w}(0), 5, 5)
end
